items.statement: Both named isomers are neutral singlets with preserved E/Z identity and individually validated optimized structures.
items.expected: Per-isomer convergence and identity evidence are present.

items.statement: ESP/LOL use individually validated molecules; intermolecular NCI uses explicitly reconstructed complete source-CIF molecular pairs with matched density/grid settings and boundary sensitivity.
items.expected: All independent crystal molecules, symmetry/translation, pair occurrences and per-central-molecule comparisons are auditable. Isolated-molecule density is not evidence of intermolecular crystal contacts.

items.statement: E ESP extrema are about -40.41 and 70.01 kcal/mol; Z extrema are about -46.88 and 79.07 kcal/mol.
items.expected: Object-labeled extrema agree with the source.

items.statement: E shows more extensive pi-stacking and hydrogen-bond NCI features and continuous LOL-p than Z.
items.expected: The paired qualitative contrast is explicitly reported.
